# HP Gives Profit Forecast Signaling Better Handle on Memory Costs

![HP Inc. signage at the New York Stock Exchange.](https://assets.bwbx.io/images/users/iqjWHBFdfxIU/iMIUZfxOkTyk/v0/-1x-1.webp)

HP Inc. signage at the New York Stock Exchange. Photographer: Michael Nagle/Bloomberg

By Dina Bass

November 24, 2026 at 9:21 PM UTC

HP Inc. gave a profit forecast for the current year that will likely exceed analysts’ estimates, signaling the computer and printer maker is improving its ability to manage rising costs associated with memory chips. The shares jumped in extended trading.

Earnings, excluding items such as restructuring costs, will be $3.15 to $3.45 a share for the year beginning this month, the company said Tuesday in a statement. Analysts, on average, projected $3.18, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.
